parameters.title: The row's words, joined to its value by the dot leader.
parameters.leading: A mark before the words (a glyph, a monogram).
parameters.value: The value at the line's end, on the leader (a LedgerAmount).
parameters.subtitle: The sub line's start words.
parameters.subtitleMonospace: The start words in the mono (an account's kind and mask).
parameters.subtitleTone: The ink of the sub line's start words.
parameters.trailingSubtitleTone: The ink of the sub line's end words.
parameters.trailing: A mark at the row's end (a chevron, a switch).
parameters.onTap: Makes the whole row one link.
parameters.semanticLabel: What a screen reader says when the row's words say too little.
parameters.focusNode: Supplies a focus node owned and disposed by the caller.
parameters.autofocus: Requests focus when the control first appears.
